teaser: A call for help: journalists, editors, students and teachers for a live newsroom run with agents, where every role should have a human.
core_idea: Journalists need to see agentic workflows and our projects lack people, so every agent role on the PHP site should have a human steering it; with no pay yet, we offer coverage, credit and learning, and payment to the people in the roles once there is revenue.
